_comment: AML / Financial-Crime STARTER employer list for ApplyPilot. Copy to config/targets.json (cp config/targets.aml-starter.json config/targets.json), then run `npm run discover` (or Find jobs in the app) to scan these boards. Every entry is a real fintech/crypto/RegTech that actively hires AML/KYC/sanctions/financial-crime analysts, and each board identifier was observed from a live job posting (job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>, jobs.lever.co/<site>) — not guessed. Boards do change ATS over time; discovery safely SKIPS any that no longer resolve (logged as a failed source, never fatal), so prune/extend freely. Add your own with `npm run companies -- add <careers-board-url>`. US roles only. Supported vendors: greenhouse | lever | ashby | smartrecruiters | workable | workday.
